rationale: PINS M60 D1. Before this, the analyzer emitted `imports`/`exports` edges FROM the file's library and published NO node for it, so at 600 files 1,755 of 1,815 `imports` sources and 10 of 10 `exports` sources resolved to nothing; a library graph had no library in it. This fixture pins three facts: (1) a Module node exists for the file, (2) its name is the DECLARED dotted name `_pins.explicit_library` and NOT the stem `library-source-pins`, so a regress-to-stem name function fails here, (3) the imports/exports edges are sourced from that same name, so edge and node cannot drift apart. The stem is deliberately different from the declared name precisely so that (2) is falsifiable.
